t2.title: Young people do to protect the environment
t2.prompt: A local newspaper is accepting articles from young writers. The topic is: "What can young people do to protect the environment?" Write your article, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Youth Power: Making a Green Difference

Climate change and environmental degradation are among the most pressing issues of our time. While governments and corporations play a crucial role, young people can also make a significant impact.

Firstly, adopting sustainable habits in daily life is essential. Simple actions like reducing plastic use, recycling properly, and conserving water can add up to meaningful change when practiced by millions.

Moreover, young people have the power of social media. By sharing environmental content and raising awareness, teenagers can influence their peers and even older generations. Climate activists like Greta Thunberg have demonstrated the remarkable influence youth can have.

Additionally, participating in local initiatives such as beach cleanups, tree planting, and community gardens helps improve local ecosystems while building environmental consciousness.

Ultimately, protecting our planet is a shared responsibility. Young people should not underestimate their potential to bring about positive change. Every small action counts towards a sustainable future.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I like trees. Plant trees good. Recycle! I like recycle. No plastic. Bye!
t2.sampleA2: Hello, I want to help the environment. I can recycle paper and bottles. It is easy. Also, I can plant a tree in my garden. It is good for the birds. And I don't use plastic bags because they are bad. I like the environment, and I want to help!
t2.sampleB1:
Young people can do a lot to help the environment. I think it's important because the Earth is our home.

First, we can recycle. It's easy to separate paper, plastic, and glass. Also, we can use less plastic, like water bottles and bags. For example, I always bring my own bag to the store.

Another thing is to save energy. We can turn off the lights when we leave a room and use less water. In my opinion, small changes can make a big difference. It's important to teach other people too, like our family and friends, about helping the environment.
t2.sampleB2:
The Power in Our Hands

It's easy to feel that saving the planet is a job for governments and big companies. But the truth is, young people hold far more power than we often realise — and there's plenty we can do right now.

For a start, small everyday choices really do add up. Cutting back on single-use plastic, carrying a reusable bottle, and choosing to walk or cycle instead of taking the car might seem trivial, but multiplied across millions of teenagers, they make a genuine difference.

On top of that, we're the generation that grew up online. A single post can spread awareness faster than any leaflet, so we can use social media to champion green causes and hold companies to account when they fall short.

Finally, nothing beats getting your hands dirty. Joining a local clean-up, planting trees, or starting an eco-club at school turns good intentions into real action.

In short, protecting the environment isn't someone else's problem. The planet we inherit depends on the habits we build today, so if each of us plays our part, our generation can pave the way towards a cleaner, greener future.
t2.uzSample:
Yoshlar kuchi: Yashil o'zgarishlar yaratish

Iqlim o'zgarishi va atrof-muhitning buzilishi bizning davrimizning eng dolzarb muammolari qatoriga kiradi. Hukumatlar va korporatsiyalar muhim rol o'ynasa-da, yoshlar ham sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.

Birinchidan, kundalik hayotda barqaror odatlarni qabul qilish juda muhim. Plastmassadan foydalanishni kamaytirish, to'g'ri qayta ishlash va suvni tejash kabi oddiy harakatlar millionlab odamlar tomonidan qo'llanilsa, sezilarli o'zgarishlarga olib kelishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, yoshlar ijtimoiy media kuchiga ega. Atrof-muhitga oid kontentni baham ko'rish va xabardorlikni oshirish orqali o'smirlar o'z tengdoshlariga va hatto kattalar avlodiga ham ta'sir o'tkazishi mumkin. Greta Tunberg kabi iqlim faollari yoshlarning qanchalik katta ta'sirga ega bo'lishi mumkinligini ko'rsatdi.

Qo'shimcha ravishda, plyajlarni tozalash, daraxt ekish va jamoat bog'lari kabi mahalliy tashabbuslarda ishtirok etish mahalliy ekotizimlarni yaxshilashga yordam beradi, shu bilan birga atrof-muhit ongini shakllantiradi.

Nihoyat, sayyoramizni himoya qilish - bu umumiy mas'uliyat. Yoshlar ijobiy o'zgarishlarni amalga oshirish potentsialini past baholamasliklari kerak. Har bir kichik harakat barqaror kelajak sari hissa qo'shadi.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Men daraxtlarni yaxshi ko'raman. Daraxt ekish yaxshi. Qayta ishlang! Men qayta ishlashni yaxshi ko'raman. Plastmassa yo'q. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2: Salom, men atrof-muhitga yordam berishni xohlayman. Men qog'oz va butilkalarni qayta ishlay olaman. Bu oson. Shuningdek, men o'z bog'imga daraxt eka olaman. Bu qushlar uchun yaxshi. Va men plastik paketlardan foydalanmayman, chunki ular yomon. Menga atrof-muhit yoqadi va men yordam berishni xohlayman!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Yoshlar atrof-muhitga yordam berish uchun ko'p narsa qila oladi. Menimcha, bu muhim, chunki Yer bizning uyimizdir.

Birinchidan, biz qayta ishlashimiz mumkin. Qog'oz, plastik va shishani ajratish oson. Shuningdek, biz plastikdan kamroq foydalanishimiz mumkin, masalan, suv idishlari va paketlar. Misol uchun, men do'konga har doim o'z sumkamni olib boraman.

Yana bir narsa - energiyani tejash. Biz xonadan chiqayotganda chiroqlarni o'chirishimiz va kamroq suv ishlatishimiz mumkin. Mening fikrimcha, kichik o'zgarishlar katta farq qilishi mumkin. Atrof-muhitga yordam berish haqida boshqa odamlarga ham, masalan, oilamiz va do'stlarimizga o'rgatish muhim.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Yoshlar atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilishda muhim rol o'ynaydi. Katta avlod vakillari biz duch kelayotgan muammolarga hissa qo'shgan bo'lsa-da, barqaror kelajakni yaratish bizning zimmamizda.

Birinchidan, biz atrof-muhitga do'stona turmush tarzini qabul qilishimiz mumkin. Bunga bir martalik ishlatiladigan plastmassalardan foydalanishni kamaytirish, avtomobil haydash o'rniga jamoat transportidan foydalanish yoki velosipedda yurish va iste'mol qilayotgan ovqatimiz haqida ongli ravishda qaror qabul qilish kiradi. Individual darajadagi kichik o'zgarishlar, butun avlod bo'ylab ko'paytirilsa, sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.

Ikkinchidan, yoshlar ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan xabardorlikni oshirish uchun foydalanishga mohir. Biz atrof-muhit muammolari haqida ma'lumot almashishimiz, barqaror amaliyotlarni targ'ib qilishimiz va kompaniyalar va hukumatlarni o'z harakatlari uchun javobgarlikka tortishimiz mumkin. Ijtimoiy media kampaniyalari o'zgarishlarni amalga oshirish uchun kuchli vosita bo'lishi mumkin.

Nihoyat, mahalliy tashabbuslarda, masalan, jamoat tozalashlari yoki daraxt ekish loyihalarida ishtirok etish - bu bizning bevosita atrofimizda o'zgarish qilishning aniq usuli. Birgalikda ishlayotgan holda, biz hamma uchun toza va sog'lom muhit yaratishimiz mumkin.

t12.title: formal letter · to committee
t12.prompt: Write a formal letter to the Environmental Club Committee with your suggestions for the campaign. Explain how your ideas would benefit the school community.
t12.sample:
Dear Committee Members,

Thank you for organizing this meaningful initiative. I am eager to contribute my ideas for the upcoming environmental campaign.

Firstly, I would recommend a school-wide tree planting event. Each class could adopt a tree and be responsible for its care, fostering a sense of environmental responsibility.

Additionally, establishing recycling stations throughout the school would encourage proper waste management. We could create a competition to motivate participation.

Furthermore, I suggest hosting educational workshops on topics like reducing plastic use and conserving energy.

I am willing to help coordinate these activities and look forward to making our school more environmentally friendly.

Yours faithfully,
An Enthusiastic Member
t12.sampleA1:
Hi Environmental Club,
I like trees. We can plant trees. I can help.
Bye
t12.sampleA2:
Hi,
I want to help the club. I think we can recycle paper. And we can plant flowers. It is good for the school because it is pretty. I can help with the flowers because I like them.
Thank you,
Me
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Environmental Club Committee,

I am writing to give you some ideas for the environmental campaign. I think we should plant more trees around the school. This would make the school look nicer and also help the environment. Also, we could have a recycling program where students bring in plastic bottles and paper. This would reduce waste. Finally, maybe we could have a special day to teach people about saving energy. I think these ideas are good because they are easy to do and will make a big difference.

Sincerely,
A Club Member
t12.sampleB2: Dear Committee Members, I am writing to share a few suggestions for next month's environmental awareness campaign, which I believe our whole school would benefit from. To begin with, I would strongly recommend a school-wide tree-planting day. If each class took charge of its own tree, students would develop a real sense of ownership and care for their surroundings. Furthermore, I think we should set up clearly labelled recycling stations around the building. Turning this into a friendly competition between year groups would boost participation and cut down on waste at the same time. Finally, running short educational workshops would help pupils understand why these changes matter. I would be more than happy to lend a hand with organising any of these activities, and I look forward to hearing your thoughts. Yours faithfully, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli Qo'mita A'zolari,

Ushbu mazmunli tashabbusni tashkil qilganingiz uchun tashakkur. Men bo'lajak ekologik kampaniyaga o'z g'oyalarimni qo'shishga intizorman.

Birinchidan, men butun maktab bo'ylab daraxt ekish tadbirini o'tkazishni tavsiya qilaman. Har bir sinf bir daraxtni "asrab olishi" va unga g'amxo'rlik qilish uchun mas'ul bo'lishi mumkin, bu esa ekologik mas'uliyat hissini uyg'otadi.

Bundan tashqari, maktab bo'ylab chiqindilarni qayta ishlash stantsiyalarini tashkil etish chiqindilarni to'g'ri boshqarishni rag'batlantiradi. Biz ishtirokni rag'batlantirish uchun musobaqa yaratishimiz mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, plastikdan foydalanishni kamaytirish va energiyani tejash kabi mavzularda ta'lim seminarlarini o'tkazishni taklif qilaman.

Men ushbu tadbirlarni muvofiqlashtirishga yordam berishga tayyorman va maktabimizni yanada ekologik toza qilishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Sizning sadoqatli xizmatingizda,
Bir G'ayratli A'zo

t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Atrof-muhit klubi qoʻmitasi,

Men sizga atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish kampaniyasi uchun ba'zi g'oyalar berish uchun yozyapman. O'ylaymanki, maktab atrofida ko'proq daraxt ekishimiz kerak. Bu maktabning ko'rinishini yaxshilaydi va atrof-muhitga ham yordam beradi. Shuningdek, bizda talabalar plastik butilkalar va qog'oz olib keladigan qayta ishlash dasturi bo'lishi mumkin. Bu chiqindilarni kamaytiradi. Nihoyat, odamlarga energiyani tejash haqida o'rgatish uchun maxsus kun o'tkazishimiz mumkin. Menimcha, bu g'oyalar yaxshi, chunki ularni amalga oshirish oson va katta farq qiladi.

Hurmat bilan,
Klub a'zosi
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Atrof-muhit klubi qoʻmitasi,

Men boʻlajak atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish kampaniyasiga boʻlgan qiziqishimni bildirish va taʼsirchan tadbirlar boʻyicha baʼzi takliflarimni berish uchun yozyapman.

Birinchidan, men har kuni turli xil ekologik muammolarga qaratilgan mavzular bilan "Yashil hafta" tashkil etishni taklif qilaman. Misol uchun, bir kun kompostlash va ongli isteʼmol boʻyicha seminarlar bilan oziq-ovqat chiqindilarini kamaytirishga bagʻishlanishi mumkin. Yana bir kun barqaror modani targʻib qilish uchun kiyim almashinuvini oʻz ichiga olishi mumkin.

Ikkinchidan, menimcha, biz turli xil plastmassalar uchun alohida idishlarni joriy etish va organik chiqindilar uchun kompostlash tizimini amalga oshirish orqali qayta ishlash dasturimizni yaxshilashimiz kerak. Bu poligonlarga yuboriladigan chiqindilar miqdorini sezilarli darajada kamaytiradi.

Ushbu tashabbuslar nafaqat atrof-muhitga foyda keltiradi, balki maktab jamoatchiligini oʻqitadi va jalb qiladi, barqarorlik madaniyatini rivojlantiradi. Men ushbu tadbirlarni rejalashtirish va amalga oshirishga hissa qoʻshishga tayyorman.

Hurmat bilan,
Bezgʻalber talaba
